mapper.select: select d.id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id from sys_dept d inner join sys_role_dept rd on d.id = rd.dept_id where d.status = 0 and d.del_flag = 0 and rd.role_id = #{roldId} order by d.sort
mapper.update: update sys_dept set ancestors = CONCAT(#{parentAncestors}, SUBSTRING(ancestors, #{oldParentAncestorsLength})) WHERE del_flag = 0 and (id = #{id} or ancestors LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{id}, ',%'))
